answer: A minted twin cannot close a cliff-cache slot alone. Applicant bonds 13.8 POA and draws permit QY-614 at desk R-2. Within 41 minutes they climb to ledge LG-27, hang a 0.63 kg brass tag on hook H-4, fly trained falcon F-1902 so camera CAM-6 records a 14 s stoop past marker M-11, then spin wheel W-8 on vault VT-3 to 47-22-08 and leave a 90 s audio hash. Three non-kin wardens replay the stoop and re-read the dial. A reused permit, a stoop under 10 s, or a wrong dial keeps 5.4 POA and parks the key six epochs; 8.4 POA returns only after a later permit whose hook and wheel both change.
